'''Peshawar Zalmi''' is a [[Pakistani]] professional [[Twenty20]] franchise [[cricket]] team based in [[Peshawar]], Pakistan, that competed in the [[2026 Pakistan Super League]]. It was the team's eleventh consecutive season in the [[Pakistan Super League]] after renewing its franchise agreement for another decade in December 2025.<ref>{{cite web |title=Peshawar Zalmi renews PSL franchise rights for another decade |url=https://www.peshawarzalmi.com/news |work=Peshawar Zalmi Official}}</ref> Peshawar were coached by [[Ottis Gibson]] and captained by [[Babar Azam]].

Peshawar finished the league stage at the top of the points table and qualified for the final after defeating [[Islamabad United]] in the Qualifier. They won their second Pakistan Super League title by defeating [[Hyderabad Kingsmen]] by five wickets in the [[2026 Pakistan Super League final]], played on 3 May 2026 at [[Gaddafi Stadium]], [[Lahore]].<ref>{{cite news |last=Ali |first=Akber |date=3 May 2026 |title=Peshawar Zalmi beat Hyderabad Kingsmen by 5 wickets, lift PSL trophy a second time |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1997223 |work=[[Dawn (newspaper)|Dawn]] |access-date=4 May 2026}}</ref>

==Squad==
[[File:Babar Azam.png|200px|thumb|right|Babar Azam was the captain and top scorer for the team in 2026.]]
[[Pakistan Super League]] introduced [[Player auction|an auction model]] for the first time in the [[2026 Pakistan Super League|2026]] season, allowing teams to select players by bidding in [[Pakistani rupees]].<ref name="D1">{{cite news |title=Player auction model to replace draft system for PSL XI |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1967839 |work=Dawn |date=19 January 2026 |language=en}}</ref> Teams were also allowed to directly sign one foreign player who was not part of [[2025 Pakistan Super League|previous season]].<ref name="D1" /> Zalmi's signed [[Aaron Hardie]] as their directly signed player. Teams were also allowed to retain up to 4 players who were part of their squads in previous seasons, while new teams were allowed to sign 4 players before the auction to match with other franchises.<ref>{{cite web |title=PSL auction to take place on 11 February |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/pakistan-news-psl-2026-auction-to-take-place-february-11-1520921 |access-date=10 February 2026}}</ref> Peshawar retained [[Babar Azam]], [[Abdul Samad (Pakistani cricketer)|Abdul Samad]], [[Sufiyan Muqeem]] and [[Ali Raza (cricketer, born 2008)|Ali Raza]] from their squad.<ref name="ret">{{cite news |title=PSL 2026 players list: Full squads for all teams and latest updates from Pakistan Super League auction {{!}} Cricket News |url=https://www.cricketnews.com/en/cricket/news/psl-2026-players-list-full-squads-all-teams-pakistan-super-league/3bbd393a06776bf26546351b#:~:text=Players%20who%20were%20not%20retained%20entered%20the,to%20four%20players%20from%20the%20unpicked%20pool. |work=www.cricketnews.com |date=11 February 2026 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Alam |first=Sher |date=2026-02-04 |title=Peshawar Zalmi Reveal Massive Retention Amounts for Star Players Ahead of PSL 11 |url=https://propakistani.pk/2026/02/04/peshawar-zalmi-reveal-massive-retention-amounts-for-star-players-ahead-of-psl-11/ |work=ProPakistani}}</ref>

[[2026 Pakistan Super League personnel signings and auction|Player auction]] for the PSL 11 was held on 11 February 2026.<ref name="ret" /> Following is the full squad of [[Peshawar Zalmi]] after the player auction and retentions.<ref name="WisdenAuction">{{cite web |title=PSL 2026 Auction: Direct overseas signings revealed |url=https://www.wisden.com/series/psl-2026/cricket-news/psl-2026-auction-full-list-of-players-with-base-price |work=Wisden |date=2026-02-10}}</ref>
